_description: Complete recipe for impact/hit effects. Covers melee hits, bullet impacts, magic hits on various surfaces.

emitter_layers.name: Flash
emitter_layers.purpose: Instant bright flash at impact point
emitter_layers.material_type: M_ImpactFlash (Additive, radial gradient or star shape)

emitter_layers.name: Sparks
emitter_layers.purpose: Bright particles streaking from impact point
emitter_layers.velocity: radial outward 300-1000 cm/s from impact normal hemisphere
emitter_layers.notes: Spawn in hemisphere aligned to surface normal (sparks fly AWAY from surface)

emitter_layers.name: Debris_Chunks
emitter_layers.notes: Size variety essential. Some tiny, some larger.

emitter_layers.name: Dust_Puff
emitter_layers.purpose: Soft dust cloud at impact point
emitter_layers.color: match surface: gray for stone, brown for dirt, light gray for concrete
emitter_layers.notes: Gives the hit weight and grounding

emitter_layers.name: Decal_Mark
emitter_layers.purpose: Impact mark on surface (bullet hole, scratch, scorch)

metal.sparks: many (15-25), bright orange, long streaks, high velocity

extra_layers: Dirt_Spray (small particles arcing up then falling)

energy_shield.flash_color: match shield color, very bright, emissive 30-80

melee_sword.notes: More spread, less precise than bullet

magic_projectile.use_surface_variant: energy_shield style but on any surface
magic_projectile.notes: Color matches spell element. No physical debris.

explosion_impact.description: Use Explosion recipe instead — this is for the ground/surface impact component only

niagara_modules_needed: Shape Location (hemisphere aligned to surface normal)
Scale Sprite Size (grow dust, shrink sparks)

key_principles.surface_normal_alignment: Impact direction/spread must align to surface normal. Sparks fly AWAY from surface, not random directions.
key_principles.scale_to_weapon: Bigger weapon = bigger impact effect. But don't make it too large — impacts should be quick and punchy.
key_principles.multiple_surface_types: AAA games have different impacts per surface (PhysMaterial). Agent should ask or infer surface type.
key_principles.frame_count: Entire impact should be mostly done in 10-20 frames (0.15-0.3s at 60fps). Only dust and decal linger.
key_principles.layering_sells_it: Flash alone looks cheap. Flash + sparks looks OK. Flash + sparks + dust + debris looks AAA.
